title: 1957 Keeping the tracks clean at train station
description: The Hartland Train Station once featured five sets of tracks, with warehouses lining the outer rails for easy freight loading. Keeping the tracks clear during winter required many hands. In November 1963, north and southbound passenger rail service, along with express and mail service, came to an end. Trains had once replaced stagecoaches and horses; now trucks and buses had taken over from the passenger train.
